## Overview
The Atlas Search team builds the full-text and vector search capabilities integrated into MongoDB Atlas. As a Software Engineer 2 you will work on indexing and query execution paths that serve thousands of production clusters.

## What you'll do
- Implement features in the query planner and the Lucene-based search engine integration.
- Diagnose latency regressions using tracing, profiling and production metrics.
- Write design documents and review code from teammates.
- Collaborate with product managers on the roadmap for vector search and hybrid ranking.

## Qualifications
- 2+ years of professional experience in Java, C++ or Go.
- Solid understanding of data structures, concurrency and distributed systems.
- Familiarity with inverted indexes, BM25 or approximate nearest neighbour search is a plus.
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent experience.

## Benefits
Hybrid work from the Gurugram office three days a week. Comprehensive health cover for you and your family, an employee stock purchase plan, generous parental leave and a yearly wellness allowance.

## Interview process
The process has four stages: a recruiter call, a coding round, a system design round on search infrastructure, and a final hiring manager conversation.
